# Yasir Lokman Teksen

> Software student at Aalborg University Copenhagen (BSc in Engineering, Software), on 3rd semester. Looking for a student job of 10 to 15 hours a week in Greater Copenhagen: software development, testing, data, IT support, cybersecurity or AI and automation.

This is his portfolio. The site is in English and Danish. It shows three projects, other study projects, his work at Bilka, his skills and ten certificates from 2026.

## Portfolio

- [Front page](https://teksen42.github.io/): projects, experience, skills, certificates and contact

## Projects

- [Kvixa](https://teksen42.github.io/#kvixa): Self-service kiosks and online ordering, used every day at a restaurant in Greve.
- [Nabolys](https://teksen42.github.io/#nabolys): A preparedness app that gets a family, and soon the neighbours, ready for the first three days of a crisis.
- [Weft](https://teksen42.github.io/#weft): One plan for work, study and training that rearranges itself when something moves.
